blurb: Located in central Mississippi in the city of Ridgeland, Main Harbor Marina is the Ross Barnett Reservoir destination for family fun. Our marina is the Reservoir’s most accessible marina complex. Our office is located in the Smith Marine building. We offer slips for houseboats, cruisers, and runabouts. With several different sizes to choose from you will be sure to find one that’s perfect for your family and budget.
